hefei-2008.notes: Source 2 is the online round (29 September 2008), not the on-site final. Source 1 holds a 15-page problem set PDF of the 33rd contest (files/83c62cad3333c4ce.pdf, eight problems A-H) and an on-site results page that matches source 3 except for one award mark, both candidates for sources of their own. The copy also holds other years' pages (2009, 2012, 2015).

hefei-2009.notes: Source 3 lists 951 teams, 856 of them unranked Honorable Mention with no solves, while the organisers' table (source 4, also inside source 1) has 102 teams; the larger list may include online-round teams, not stated on the page. Source 4 is the rank.htm page of source 1's crawl. The site's schedule marks the on-site dates as provisional.

hefei-2015.notes: Source 3 lists 97 teams: the 94 of source 2 plus three marked with an asterisk (two USTC teams and JiSuanKe). Its per-problem totals differ slightly from source 2 (D 12/38 against 13/40, E 42/217 against 43/230). Source 1 was captured in September 2015 and has no on-site material.
